title: Tribute Summon L4-2
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'tribute_summon', level 4, variant 2. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Tribute Mystical Elf, La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp for Ancient Gear Golem, then attack for exactly 3000.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Normal Summon Vampire Orchis and use its effect to special summon Des Dendle.
Equip the Orchis with the union card.
Revive Cannon Soldier with Premature Burial.
Attack your opponents Silpheed with your Orchis. Silpheed will be destroyed, but the Orchis will be protected by its union card. You will still get the Wicked Plant Token.
Have your remaining monsters attack directly.
Tribute all monsters (and finally, Cannon soldier himself) to inflict direct damage for game.
